comment: Reviewed mapping from Maven POM <license><name> to SPDX for licenses/android-runtime.json. An unknown name, several POM licenses without a review below, or a license outside deny.toml's allow list fails `npm run licenses`.

Apache-2.0.source: androidx.core:core:1.16.0 META-INF/androidx/core/core/LICENSE.txt (the Apache License 2.0 text AndroidX ships)

reviews.name: jna
reviews.reason: The POM comments and the jar's META-INF/LICENSE (SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR LGPL-2.1-or-later) state a free choice between the two; Oink takes Apache-2.0.
